title.en: Sign-in interface, update page, 24 browser tests
title.zh: 登录接口、更新页、24 项浏览器测试

summary.en: Account settings (R-012), the admin/update page with reload-after-update (R-013, R-027) and the Google/Apple sign-in interface (R-023: backend + buttons, hidden until credentials exist) are merged and in review. A new browser test suite (R-032) drives the real app in 3 languages x light/dark: 24 of 24 pass; screenshots below are from those runs. The backend test suite grew to 39 API tests (R-030, review) and found a real bug (malformed JSON got a plain-text error, B-004), now fixed. A flaky approval test was traced to a port race in the test harness and fixed (30/30 passes). Checks after merging: cargo clippy zero warnings; unit 180, API 39, approval 12, share 7; web app build, lint (2 known warnings in the update watcher) and 111 tests. Not done: the update page was only tested with stubbed server answers; real Google/Apple login waits for your developer credentials; R-012/R-013 were not hand-tested against a real device; phone layout is not covered by the browser tests.
summary.zh: 账户设置（R-012）、管理/更新页与更新后自动刷新（R-013、R-027）、Google/Apple 登录接口（R-023：后端加按钮，凭据到位前按钮隐藏）均已合并，待验收。新的浏览器测试套件（R-032）在真实应用上跑 3 种语言 x 浅色/深色：24 项全部通过，下方截图来自这些测试。后端测试增至 39 项 API 测试（R-030，待验收），并发现一个真实缺陷（格式错误的 JSON 返回纯文本错误，B-004），已修复。一个不稳定的审批测试被查明是测试脚手架的端口竞争，已修复（30/30 通过）。合并后检查：cargo clippy 无警告；单元 180、API 39、审批 12、分享 7；网页应用构建、静态检查（更新监视器有 2 条已知警告）与 111 项测试通过。未完成：更新页只用模拟的服务端响应测过；真实的 Google/Apple 登录要等你的开发者凭据；R-012/R-013 未在真机上手测；浏览器测试未覆盖手机布局。

bullets.en: **R-012, R-013, R-027, R-023, R-030, R-032 (review):** built, merged, checked as described above.
**B-004 (fixed):** every bad JSON body now returns the standard JSON error with a stable code (INVALID_JSON, INVALID_BODY, UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE).
bullets.zh: **B-004（已修复）：**所有错误的 JSON 请求体现在返回带稳定错误码的标准 JSON 错误。

bullets.en: **Sign-in design choice:** a Google/Apple login is only linked to an existing account when that account's email is already verified; otherwise it is refused. This avoids someone registering your email and absorbing your later Google login (until R-024).
bullets.zh: **登录设计选择：**只有当已有账户的邮箱已验证时，才会把 Google/Apple 登录关联到该账户，否则拒绝。这样可避免别人先用你的邮箱注册、再占用你以后的 Google 登录（R-024 完成前）。
